verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Mintlify acting as an MCP *server* (hosted search MCP, admin/write MCP, Index MCP) that other AI tools like Claude/Cursor can connect to — none of it shows Mintlify's own agents (editor agent, automation agent, assistant) being able to consume or plug in external MCP servers to gain new tools. The axis applies since Mintlify ships agentic features that could in principle take external tool inputs, but no evidence supports a client-side MCP integration.
